Give one endpoint a different lifetime from the default. The most specific pattern wins, so a broad games.roblox.com rule can set a house default while one exact path overrides it.

A lifetime of 0 means never cache this endpoint: that is how you exclude something without switching the whole cache off.

Examples: games.roblox.com/v1/games/votes at 600: vote counts barely move, so one request to Roblox every ten minutes is plenty. games.roblox.com/v1/games/*/servers at 0: a live server list is worthless if it is even slightly out of date, so never save it.
